text: The Patient Robot e The rover (and the computational resources that support it) should do things | don't have the patience, senses, memory or computational capability to do. A rover's eye view of the terrain e Patience o Surveying locations of all of the black mustard. o Observing rabbit behavior. o Watching an anthill all day. e Senses o Detecting black mustard right after it sprouts. o Infrared camera to see rabbits at night. o Seeing all the ants going into the anthill and coming out at once. e Computational Capacity o Counting all of the black mustard plants. o Observing exactly where rabbits are, and what they do. o Counting the ants moving in and out of the anthill. e Memory o Keeping a record of where all the black mustard plants are, and how that changes over time. o Keeping a record of where the rabbits were, when, and what they did. o Keeping a record of how many ants there were, when - and environmental factors. e Computational Capacity and Memory o Can | determine when to harvest the black mustard? (And - can actuators on the rover help?) o What are the rabbits eating? And what is eating my succulents? o Which factors influence ant activity, and how?
